title: NANSEN entity method (DRAFT)
description: DRAFT, consumed from step 4. Declares a method that runs on entities of one type: where its code is, and the JSON Schema of its options. The frontend renders option forms from that schema.

entryPoint.description: MATLAB: a function or class name, e.g. 'ophys.motionCorrect'. Python: 'module.path:function'.

batchMode.description: serial: called once per entity. batch: called once with all selected entities.

options.description: A draft-07 JSON Schema for the method's options object. Defaults in it are the default options.
